title: JMAP config: Mailbox/set creates/destroys newsgroup subscriptions
description: In Mailbox/set handler: if create request has name matching a newsgroup pattern (contains a dot, no spaces), subscribe to that group (add to in-memory group set, trigger gossipsub subscription). On destroy: unsubscribe from group with a configurable grace period (default 24h, configurable unsubscribe_grace_period_secs). Blocked on: stoa-3ea48ee7.
